statements.text: An agreement between the US and Russia was reached on 9 October. On 11 October President Trump announced a reciprocal energy ceasefire.
The UK announced a new sanctions package, so that over 90% of Russia's oil producing capacity is now covered by UK sanctions.

The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages to provide urgent support in the coming weeks. The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.
The Prime Minister set out the UK's latest package of Lightweight Multirole Missiles for Ukraine.
Britain decided to send air defence and a Voyager aircraft to Saudi Arabia to provide air-to-air refuelling support.

In Berlin, the Prime Minister and Chancellor Merz agreed a new partnership to tackle hybrid threats. In his UN General Assembly speech, the Prime Minister confirmed a commitment to establish a National Centre for Information Defence.
The UK-EU summit will take place in Brussels on 20 November.

The government has confirmed the Derby headquarters decision for Great British Railways, a milestone in its plan for a publicly owned railway. The headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff, and better public transport links and walking routes are being delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority. The site was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.
A £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north is set to be built at Alstom's Derby site.
Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship, with the first starters based in Derby.
Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years as rail services have moved into public ownership.
